ALL_OF.observable: One adult human-shaped female face/head and neck on siren, with visible dark eyes and short dark bob cues.
The same human neck enters one feather-covered avian trunk; junction is visible.
Exactly two feathered wings visibly root in that same avian trunk.
Exactly two scaly avian legs end in taloned feet gripping the stone support, connected to the trunk.
Feathered bird tail is continuous with same trunk.

keyword_tests.same_entity_join: human neck -> bird trunk -> two wing roots, two avian legs, feathered tail
confusion_boundaries: bird trunk must be visible, not just a woman with wing accessories
bird lower body with talons, not a mermaid fish tail
human face has a human mouth rather than eagle beak

ALL_OF.observable: A lion head/mane connects to one tawny quadruped lion torso with four feline paw legs.
One horned goat head and neck rise directly from the middle of that same lion back; dorsal junction visible.
A scaly tail starts at lion rump, follows a visible continuous curve, and ends in one distinct snake head.
Lion head, goat head and snake head all belong to the same continuous body; no independent goat or snake stands beside it.

keyword_tests.same_entity_join: lion head -> lion torso/back -> dorsal goat neck/head; lion rump -> snake-tail curve -> snake head
confusion_boundaries: separate lion/goat/snake trio is not chimera
ordinary lion with ornamental goat emblem does not satisfy dorsal anatomy
lion with ordinary feline tail or unrelated ground snake fails snake-tail endpoint

shared_scene_tests.observable: Exactly one siren and one chimera occupy the same floor/stage with separated contours and independent anatomies.
All required junctions and appendages are in frame and sufficiently exposed to inspect.

primary_sources.used_for: human head plus bird body and claws; human-bird rather than later mermaid variant
lion, goat head from back, tail terminating in snake head
